mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_flow_event_outbox (event_id, tenant_id, process_instance_id, event_type, process_def_key, destination_type, destination, payload, created_at, delivery_status) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{eventType}, #{processDefKey}, #{destinationType}, #{destination}, #{payload}, #{createdAt}, 'RECORDED')
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, tenant_id, process_instance_id, event_type, process_def_key, destination_type, destination, payload, created_at FROM sys_flow_event_outbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND delivery_status = 'RECORDED'
